name: Apploye
description: Apploye is a comprehensive time tracking and productivity management tool designed to help businesses monitor employee performance and optimize workflow efficiency. It offers features like time tracking, employee monitoring, and project management to enhance productivity.

events.d: Retrieve organizations in your account, optionally returning only selected fields.
Retrieve a paginated list of your organization’s members and key details (user ID, name, timezone). Supports filters for updated-since date, timezone, and selecting specific fields.
Get clients with pagination, optional updated-since filtering, and optional field selection.
Retrieve projects with pagination. Filter by creator and Updated Since (preset, days, or custom date/time/timezone). Optionally return only selected fields.
List invoices with pagination and optional filters for status, client, issued date range, and updated since.
Retrieve timesheets with pagination. Optionally filter by date range (preset or custom), updated since (preset or custom), user (ID or email), team, or project.
